tasks.label: clean
args: Remove-Item -Recurse -Force '${workspaceFolder}\bin','${workspaceFolder}\obj','${workspaceFolder}\*.obj','${workspaceFolder}\*.pdb','${workspaceFolder}\*.ilk' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path '${workspaceFolder}\bin' | Out-Null; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path '${workspaceFolder}\obj' | Out-Null

tasks.label: build
args: cd '${workspaceFolder}'; if (-Not (Test-Path 'obj')) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path 'obj' | Out-Null }; if (-Not (Test-Path 'bin')) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path 'bin' | Out-Null }; cl.exe /EHsc /Fo:obj\${fileBasenameNoExtension}.obj /Fd:obj\${fileBasenameNoExtension}.pdb /Fe:bin\${fileBasenameNoExtension}.exe '${file}'

tasks.label: run
args: cd '${workspaceFolder}'; if (-Not (Test-Path 'obj')) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path 'obj' | Out-Null }; if (-Not (Test-Path 'bin')) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path 'bin' | Out-Null }; cl.exe /EHsc /Fo:obj\${fileBasenameNoExtension}.obj /Fd:obj\${fileBasenameNoExtension}.pdb /Fe:bin\${fileBasenameNoExtension}.exe '${file}' && .\bin\${fileBasenameNoExtension}.exe; Remove-Item -Recurse -Force 'bin','obj','*.obj','*.pdb','*.ilk' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
